newsitem.title: CHINA: China Jan-April fixed asset investment up 15 pct.
newsitem.headline: China Jan-April fixed asset investment up 15 pct.

text.p: China's fixed asset investment rose 15 percent to 242.5 billion yuan ($29.2 billion) in the first four months compared with the year-ago period, the State Statistical Bureau said on Monday.
Construction began on a total of 9,773 new projects nationwide between January and April, up 31.4 percent from the same 1996 period, the bureau said in a statement.
The projects would involve total investment of 130.9 billion yuan, up 33 percent from the year-ago period, it said.
China's first quarter fixed asset investment grew a year-on-year 13.9 percent.
Fixed asset investment is closely watched by economists as it is seen as a measure of longer term demand for credit.
Many economists have been pressing for a relaxation in controls on fixed asset investment following the government's recent successes in keeping inflation under control.
